symptom: CI #40283770521 research-governance Typecheck failed TS18046 in forwardV02IndependentVerifierNegativeCatalog.test.ts at the usageRules comparison callback. The code narrowed input.usageRules with Array.isArray, then accessed the same mutable record property inside Array.some; TypeScript did not preserve that property narrowing across the closure. Process exited 1; checkout post-job succeeded; no runner failure was demonstrated. This is a typecheck failure, not a verifier failure.
lesson: Narrowing a property of a mutable Record<string, unknown> outside a callback does not guarantee that the property is narrowed inside the callback; TypeScript correctly treats the property access as potentially changed.
guardrail: Capture the unknown record property in a local const before Array.isArray narrowing, then use that narrowed local inside Array.some/every callbacks. Verify the actual CI typecheck and do not attribute TS18046 to test payload or runner infrastructure.
